display.purpose: Airport codes on a flight's route hero; 3.25rem on phones.

headline.purpose: The lead sentence on Home and Flights, max 31em, balanced; 1.5rem on phones.

headline-figure.purpose: Figures inside a lead sentence: 650 weight, tabular.

headline-flight.purpose: The lead sentence on a flight, max 34em; 1.25rem on phones.

route.purpose: Route codes in the most-recent block; 1.875rem on phones.

clock.purpose: Times in the times strip; 1.5rem on phones.

title-small.purpose: Month headings in the flight list.

body-small.purpose: Most interface text: nav, buttons, meta lines, row cells, menu items.

label.purpose: Column heads, time labels, definition terms, legends, tooltips, the globe hint line, footer.

chart-label.purpose: Axis ticks and bar values; airport codes on maps and the globe at 600.

wordmark.purpose: The product name in the header only, in capitals.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Menus and pickers on their surface-mid fill.

shadows.name: fab
shadows.purpose: The floating Add button on phones.

shadows.name: globe-control
shadows.purpose: Round buttons floating over the globe.

shadows.name: flash
shadows.purpose: Ring that fades over 1.2s on the aircraft card when a lead-sentence phrase points at it.

shadows.name: focus-field
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on inputs and selects, with a focus-gold border.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing; used by every transition.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Hover colour and background changes on buttons, links, inputs (rows 140ms).

motion.name: duration-control
motion.purpose: Segment selection and check scale, phrase wash, chevron, phone tab pill, toast.

motion.name: globe-inertia
motion.purpose: The globe keeps turning after a quick drag release and slows to a stop.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: list-compact
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: flight list drops aircraft and distance columns.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: 16px gutter, bottom navigation bar with icon pills, floating Add button, single-column grids, gallery strip, two-line rows, 2x2 times strip, 24px map corners, edge-to-edge globe stage.

breakpoints.name: map-disc
breakpoints.purpose: Map container width below which Flights and flight maps become a disc (orthographic or azimuthal equal-area).

themes.override: data-theme="light" | "dark" on the root element, stored by the theme button

dateTime.rule: Every precise time is shown with its date and UTC offset, 24-hour airport-local, with a +N day chip when the date changes.

icons.size: 1em; 16px in buttons, 18px in icon buttons and globe controls, 22px in the phone navigation bar, 24px in the floating Add button

stateLayers.note: Material-style state layers over pills, icon buttons, nav links, segments, chips and menu items.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action in a view: an ink pill with paper text.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary" type="button"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg>Add</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn .ds-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); color: var(--paper, #faf8f1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--btn-hover, #3a3631); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action: a transparent pill with a hairline outline and Material state layers; a small 34px size exists.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-hover, #bdb5a3); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet--small { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--state-hover, rgba(31,29,26,0.08)); } .ds-btn-quiet:active { background: var(--state-press, rgba(31,29,26,0.12)); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Add Button
components.description: Phones only: a 56px button with 16px corners in the selection container, above the navigation bar; hidden on the globe page.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" type="button" aria-label="Add"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--selected-container, #eee1c5); color: var(--on-selected-container, #211b0a); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(31,29,26,0.2), 0 4px 12px rgba(31,29,26,0.16); cursor: pointer; position: relative; isolation: isolate; } .ds-fab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: transparent; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-fab:hover::after { background: var(--state-hover, rgba(31,29,26,0.08)); } .ds-fab:active::after { background: var(--state-press, rgba(31,29,26,0.12)); } .ds-fab .ds-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Period Control
components.description: Outlined pill of equal-width 40px segments; the selected one fills with the selection container and shows a check; width never changes.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #d3ccbc); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg__b { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); position: relative; height: 40px; padding: 0 30px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #d3ccbc); background: transparent; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #534e46); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-seg__b:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-seg__b:hover { background: var(--state-hover, rgba(31,29,26,0.08)); color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); } .ds-seg__b[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--selected-container, #eee1c5); color: var(--on-selected-container, #211b0a); } .ds-seg__check { position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 50%; width: 15px; height: 15px; stroke-width: 2.25; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.6); transition: opacity 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-seg__b[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-seg__check { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1); } .ds-seg__b:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: -3px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Layer Chips
components.description: 8px-cornered toggles with their legend swatch; on fills with the selection container and drops the outline.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #d3ccbc); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #534e46); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--state-hover, rgba(31,29,26,0.08)); color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--selected-container, #eee1c5); border-color: transparent; color: var(--on-selected-container, #211b0a); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-swatch-line { width: 18px; border-top: 2px solid var(--flown, #c48400); } .ds-swatch-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--spotted, #4559a9); }

components.name: Lead Sentence
components.description: Signature: the view's point as one sentence, figures at 650, data phrases underlined 2px in their ink.
components.html: This year you took 23 flights over 61,480 km, on 14 routes, and photographed 212 aircraft, 9 of them ones you also flew on.
components.css: .ds-lead { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.32; letter-spacing: -0.02em; max-width: 31em; margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); } .ds-fig { font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-phrase { cursor: pointer; border-radius: 2px; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 100% 2px; background-position: 0 calc(100% - 0.04em); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); box-decoration-break: clone; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; } .ds-phrase--flown { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--flown, #c48400), var(--flown, #c48400)); } .ds-phrase--spotted { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--spotted, #4559a9), var(--spotted, #4559a9)); } .ds-phrase--both { background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--flown, #c48400) 0 50%, var(--spotted, #4559a9) 50% 100%); } .ds-phrase--flown:hover { background-color: var(--flown-wash, rgba(196,132,0,0.1)); } .ds-phrase--spotted:hover { background-color: var(--spotted-wash, rgba(69,89,169,0.12)); } .ds-phrase--both:hover { background-color: var(--hover, rgba(31,29,26,0.05)); } .ds-phrase:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Aircraft Card
components.description: Gallery-style photo card with 20px corners: photo flush on top, tonal caption block, events with data-ink dots, photographer credit pinned to the bottom.
components.html:
G-ABCD
G-ABCDAirbus A320neo
  • Flown twice
  • Spotted 3 May

Photo: A. Photographer · planespotters.net
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 260px; border-radius: var(--radius, 20px); background: var(--surface-low, #f5f0e5); overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(31,29,26,0.12), 0 4px 14px rgba(31,29,26,0.08); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card__photo { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--paper-3, #e8e3d6); color: var(--ink-3, #6e685e); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-card__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 14px 16px 16px; } .ds-card__reg { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-card__type { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-2, #534e46); } .ds-card__events { list-style: none; margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 3px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-2, #534e46); } .ds-card__events li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-dot--flown { background: var(--flown, #c48400); } .ds-dot--spotted { background: var(--spotted, #4559a9); } .ds-credit { margin: 0; padding-top: 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-3, #6e685e); } .ds-credit a { color: inherit; }

components.name: Flight List Row
components.description: Grid row aligned on the first baseline with a 14px state layer; route codes with a gold arc arrow, tabular numbers right-aligned, outlined Review pill when a check needs a look.
components.html: Tue 4 Mar2025AAABBBReviewAlpha City to Bravo CityXY 123Example Air13 h 05
components.css: .ds-row { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(190px, 1.4fr) minmax(120px, 1fr) 80px; gap: 16px; align-items: first baseline; padding: 14px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4dfd3); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--surface-mid, #f2ede2); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row__date, .ds-row__cell { font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-2, #534e46); line-height: 1.35; } .ds-row__date b { display: block; color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); font-weight: 600; } .ds-row__cell b { display: block; color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); font-weight: 500; } .ds-row__route { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-arrow { width: 22px; height: 10px; color: var(--flown, #c48400); } .ds-row__cities { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-3, #6e685e); } .ds-row__num { font-size: 0.9375rem; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #d3ccbc); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip .ds-icon { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

components.name: Times Strip Cell

components.css: .ds-times { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4dfd3); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4dfd3); color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); } .ds-time { padding: 18px 20px 18px 0; } .ds-time + .ds-time { padding-left: 20px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4dfd3); } .ds-time p { margin: 0; } .ds-time__label { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-3, #6e685e); } .ds-time__clock { margin-top: 4px !important; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.1; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-time__date { margin-top: 4px !important; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-2, #534e46); } .ds-plus { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #d3ccbc); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A filled pill on surface-high; lighter on hover; on focus it turns surface-lowest with the focus border and halo.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Search route, flight, aircraft"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; max-width: 380px; } .ds-search .ds-icon { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--ink-3, #6e685e); } .ds-input { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); width: 100%; height: 46px; padding: 0 12px 0 44px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-high, #ede8dd); color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #6e685e); } .ds-input:hover { background: var(--surface-highest, #e7e2d7); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--focus, #b58a00); background: var(--surface-lowest, #fffdf8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-wash, rgba(247,190,2,0.3)); }

components.name: Header Band
components.description: Sticky tonal band (surface-mid, no hairline): tracked wordmark, pill nav links with the current page in the selection container, tools on the right.
components.html:
TOUCHDOWN
HomeFlightsSpottingStats
components.css: .ds-head { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; background: var(--surface-mid, #f2ede2); color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); } .ds-word { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-right: auto; } .ds-nav__a { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-2, #534e46); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav__a:hover { background: var(--state-hover, rgba(31,29,26,0.08)); color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); } .ds-nav__a[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--selected-container, #eee1c5); color: var(--on-selected-container, #211b0a); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav__a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-addbtn { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); color: var(--paper, #faf8f1); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-addbtn:hover { background: var(--btn-hover, #3a3631); } .ds-addbtn .ds-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

components.name: Phone Navigation Bar
components.description: Bottom bar on phones: surface-mid, icons above labels, a selection-container pill behind the current tab's icon.
components.html: HomeFlightsSpottingStats
components.css: .ds-tabs { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); max-width: 400px; padding: 10px 0 8px; background: var(--surface-mid, #f2ede2); } .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 4px 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #534e46); text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab .ds-icon { box-sizing: content-box; width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 5px 20px; border-radius: 999px; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tab:hover .ds-icon { background: var(--state-hover, rgba(31,29,26,0.08)); } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); font-weight: 650; } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] .ds-icon { background: var(--selected-container, #eee1c5); color: var(--on-selected-container, #211b0a); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-findings { display: grid; gap: 8px; max-width: 520px; } .ds-finding { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-low, #f5f0e5); font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); } .ds-finding p { margin: 0; } .ds-finding .ds-icon { flex: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--ink-3, #6e685e); } .ds-finding--error { background: var(--alert-wash, rgba(186,26,26,0.08)); } .ds-finding--error .ds-icon { color: var(--alert, #ba1a1a); }

components.name: Map Container and Legend
components.description: Every map sits in a 28px rounded tonal container; overview legends end with the "Explore on a globe" pill.
components.html: FlightsNot recordedSpottingExplore on a globe
components.css: .ds-mapwrap { font-family: var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 640px; } .ds-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 20px; padding-inline: 4px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-2, #534e46); } .ds-legend__item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-swatch-line { width: 18px; border-top: 2px solid var(--flown, #c48400); } .ds-swatch-line--gap { border-top-style: dashed; } .ds-swatch-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--spotted, #4559a9); } .ds-legend__action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-left: auto; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-high, #ede8dd); color: var(--ink, #1f1d1a); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-legend__action:hover { background: var(--surface-highest, #e7e2d7); } .ds-legend__action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #b58a00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-legend__action .ds-icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; } .ds-map { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--surface-low, #f5f0e5); }

components.name: Globe Stage

narrative.overview:
Each view states its main point as one plain sentence with the figures inside it, then shows one subject at full size underneath: the period's map on Home, the period's routes on Flights, the route on a flight, the whole period on the globe. Supporting context (most recent, aircraft cards, month by month, the flight list) sits below in quiet sections divided by hairline rules. The world comes from the owner's own lab site and photo gallery: warm paper ground, one sans family, a narrow reading measure, hairlines between sections, and rounded photo cards with a tinted caption block.

On that ground sits a layer borrowed from Material You, deliberately not exact Material: its shapes (pill buttons, round icon buttons, large rounded containers), its tonal surfaces (a warm neutral palette at the page's hue) and its state layers. Material's colour roles are not borrowed: buttons stay ink and neutral, and gold and blue stay data only. The one non-data tint is a muted gold container that marks what is selected. This document describes the shipped web app (`apps/web`); the prototype in `prototype/` is the earlier reference and does not have the Material layer.

Colour is reserved for data. Flown is gold, spotted is blue, and everything else is paper, tonal surface and ink. The page is flat and calm; depth appears only on things that float above it (menus, tooltips, toasts, the floating Add button, the globe's controls) and on a card under the pointer. Density is moderate: generous vertical spacing between sections, compact rows inside lists, and tabular figures wherever numbers line up.

The system refuses the KPI-tile grid and the flight-tracker wall of panels. A statistic belongs in a sentence or a chart with its own counted-what subtitle, not in a box of its own.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground in light, warm near-black in dark; both follow the device by default.
One system sans for every role; display weight 650 with tight negative tracking.
Two data inks, flown gold and spotted blue, and no other decorative colour.
Lead sentences with phrases underlined in their data ink that point at the map or the aircraft.
Tonal surfaces and hairline rules instead of outlined boxes; pill-shaped controls and large rounded containers.
Selection shown by a muted gold container, never by a data ink.
Credited photo cards with 20px corners and a tinted caption block.
Every precise time shown with its date and UTC offset.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Flown gold and spotted blue are the only data colours. A chart, map layer, dot or underline about flights is gold; about spotting is blue; about both is split half gold, half blue. No third data colour is introduced; new series are separated by position, dash or label.

rules.name: The Validated Pair Rule
rules.body: Each data ink has a light and a dark value that were checked against their own ground (`flown` and `spotted` on `paper`; `flown-dark` and `spotted-dark` on `paper-dark`). Use the pair together; do not lift one theme's ink into the other. The gold mark happens to pass on both grounds, so `flown` and `flown-dark` share one value; the navy is too dark for the dark ground and steps up to a lighter tone there; both text shades (`-ink`) always differ by theme.

rules.name: The Word With The Icon Rule
rules.body: Status is never colour alone. A status line pairs an icon with a written word or sentence ("Needs a look.", "All checks passed: ..."); only the passed icon carries `good`.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Sans-serif only, from the system stack. No serif, no webfont, no monospace. Contrast comes from weight (400, 500, 600, 650, 700) and size.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that sits in a column, a strip, a chart or a lead-sentence figure uses tabular figures, so values align and do not shift as they change.

rules.name: The Dated Time Rule
rules.body: Every precise time is shown with its date and its UTC offset (for example "Tue 4 Mar · UTC+8"), in 24-hour local time of the airport, with a "+1 day" chip when the landing date differs. A clock time never appears alone.

rules.name: The One Subject Rule
rules.body: Each view has one full-width subject directly under its sentence. Supporting material goes below it in sections, never beside it in a panel wall.

rules.name: The Constant Width Rule
rules.body: Controls whose label changes reserve the width of their longest possible label, so selecting a value never moves the layout.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing resting on the page casts a shadow. A shadow means "this floats" or "this responds to you".

rules.name: The Borrowed Shapes Rule
rules.body: The Material layer borrows shapes, tonal surfaces and state layers, never Material's colour roles. Buttons are ink (primary) or neutral (quiet, ghost); no button, tab or control is filled with a data ink. Selection uses the muted gold container; gold and blue stay data only.

dos: Do keep `paper` (#FAF8F1) as the light ground and `paper-dark` as the dark ground, and support both themes, following the device unless the user picks one.
Do colour flight data gold and spotting data blue, using each theme's validated pair, and split the two for data that is both.
Do open each view with one plain sentence carrying its figures, and underline data phrases 2px in their ink so they point at the map layer or the aircraft.
Do show every precise time with its date and UTC offset, in 24-hour airport-local time.
Do use tabular figures for every number that aligns or updates.
Do give every status an icon and a word.
Do credit every aircraft photo with the photographer and a link to the source.
Do reserve the longest label's width in controls whose label changes.
Do align multi-line list rows on their first baseline.
Do separate sections with hairlines and space, and use the `surface-*` steps for raised areas.
Do make everything you press a pill (chips excepted, at 8px), and show selection with `selected-container` and its `on-selected-container` text.
Do put every map in a 28px rounded tonal container (24px on phones), with the "Explore on a globe" link in the legend of overview maps.
donts: Don't use a serif, a webfont or a monospace face; the system sans covers every role.
Don't add a third data colour or use the data inks as decoration; gold outside data is limited to focus, caret, text selection, the checkbox accent and the muted selection container.
Don't fill a button, tab or navigation item with flown gold or spotted blue; buttons stay ink or neutral.
Don't build KPI tiles or a wall of side panels; a figure belongs in a sentence or a chart.
Don't show a clock time without its date, or a status by colour alone.
Don't put shadows on anything resting on the page.
Don't add small uppercase labels above headings; the wordmark is the only tracked capitals in the interface.
